name: nitter
one_liner: A private, ad-free, faster way to read Twitter/X pages without an account or tracking.
buyer: Honestly, almost no one should build a business on this today. As of August 2026 X Corp sent cease-and-desist letters demanding instances and the repo be taken down.
business_use_cases: Personal use only: read public X profiles privately on a VPS you run yourself.
Academic archiving of public posts, where permitted, before they disappear.
A cautionary case study in how fragile a business built on another platform's data can be.

money_ideas.idea: There is no safe money model here. Running a public instance now invites legal action. Treat it as a privacy tool for yourself, not a product.

steal_this: Don't ship this one. The real lesson to steal: if your product depends entirely on scraping one company's site, one letter can end it. Build on data you own or license.
